stable.label: matter-lab-0.4-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.4 is integrated after a fully green pull-request CI run. Overall product remains unverified because the live GitHub.io deployment and real iPhone Safari have not been independently exercised.

capabilities: reversible pair association between unlike generic species
explicit forward and reverse toy reaction events
internal transformed particle state on reacted associations
transformed pair state changes coarse-grained pair interaction

active_objective: Move from single reacted pairs toward explicit multi-particle topology and simple reaction-network bookkeeping while keeping the playable baseline intact and the model claims honest.
next_gate: Add a tested multi-particle topology layer or small reaction network as the next isolated Lab increment; do not call the toy event model real chemistry.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Toy reaction events must not be described as validated chemistry
Particle state transformation must conserve particle count
